description: Part 2, For KRW readers (G-09, Deeper). The lambda-tau conversions (cf.lambda25.tau, cf.lambda1.tau, cf.tau25.lambda), the KRW race card's summary values (krw.race.card.*) and its KRW risk at lambda = .25 (krw.race.card.lambda25.krwrisk), the lambda = 1 grid card's DR (krw.grid.race.lambda1.DR) and the six-site fixed report 1/1/2/2/3/3 (six.A.cap3.tau20.*) are keys of part2.json and numbers-cases.json; this fragment adds what the G-09 page writes about the lambda = 1 endpoint (the six sites' best report at tau = 1/2 and its two risks, the number of grades of KRW's lambda = 1 grid card) and two counts of the race card's direction table (the size of its third grade and the number of firms above a third-grade firm).

g09.six.note: the released error array of score A (data/released/six-sites.json)

g09.six.all.tau50.note: the exact optimum among all 4,683 reports at tau = 1/2 (lambda = 1)

g09.six.all.tau50.grades.note: the full order A > B > C > D > E > F (oracle row exactOptimum-six-A-all-tau.50)

g09.six.all.tau50.risk.note: postrank's risk of the full order at tau = 1/2 (oracle row exactOptimum-six-A-all-tau.50)

g09.six.all.tau50.krwrisk.note: KRW's risk of the same report at lambda = 1 (oracle row krwRisk-six-strict-lambda1); tau + (1 - tau) times it is the risk above

g09.krw.grid.lambda1.G.note: the number of grades of KRW's lambda = 1 race grid card (KRW's Condorcet ranks): every firm alone

g09.krw.race.card.size3.note: the firms in the race card's third grade (the size of the second grade is krw.race.card.size2)

g09.krw.race.card.above3.note: the firms in higher-priority grades than a third-grade firm (row position 6 is in grade 3): KRW's reconstruction gives it 1 + this count

g09.krw.grid.firstlambda.note: the first positive lambda of KRW's grid, gathered as a one-state law (the grid starts at 0, an endpoint outside postrank)
